question.prompt: For the graph of the inverse proportional function \(y=(2m-1)/x\), \(y\) increases as \(x\) increases within each quadrant. Find the greatest integer value of \(m\).

solutions.explanation: For \(y\) to increase as \(x\) increases, we need \(k=2m-1<0\), so \(m<1/2\). The greatest integer satisfying this condition is 0.
solutions.title: Translate increase into an inequality
